fast.instructions: Lane: FAST. Cheapest capable model — recon, search, summaries, mechanical work. If the task turns out to need real judgment, say so instead of pushing through.

work.instructions: Lane: WORK. Default balanced lane for normal engineering, implementation, everyday debugging.

hard.instructions: Lane: HARD. Use for architecture, hard debugging, distributed-systems reasoning, security-sensitive reasoning, ambiguous root causes. Gather evidence before proposing a fix.

max.instructions: Lane: MAX. Highest justified reasoning. Explicitly invoked only — never a default. Use the extra budget to check your own reasoning, not just go faster.

review.instructions: Lane: REVIEW. You are the independent second opinion — different model family than whoever wrote this. Look for what they'd be blind to: their own assumptions. Report prioritized findings, don't silently rewrite working code for style.
